newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy 10-year Btp/Bund spread falls below 150 bps.
newsitem.headline: Italy 10-year Btp/Bund spread falls below 150 bps.

text.p: The spread between the 10-year Italian benchmark Btp government bond and the German benchmark July 4, 2007 Bund fell below 150 basis points to touch a record low at 148 bps, traders said.
At 1142 GMT, the spread had widened slightly back to 151 bps. The February 1, 2007 Btp was trading 10 bps off at 97.47 after an earlier high at 97.72.
